rules.connected_means: A continuous route exists by ski lifts and marked pistes; a shared brand or pass does not by itself count as a physical link.
rules.counts: No lift-ride counts, fastest routes or ability matrices until the lift/piste graph is reproducible and checked against the official 2026/27 map.
rules.data_types: Operator-reported, independent-reported, map-derived and modelled values must remain separate.

groups.name: Main connected core
groups.note: The group is named by the Saint-Sorlin official ski-area page. Pairwise lift/piste edges and route dependencies still require a map audit.

groups.name: Saint-Colomban-des-Villards
groups.status: connection disputed / likely disconnected from main core
groups.note: An independent resort guide says the ski link was no longer maintained from winter 2025-26; current official map and pass terms need confirmation.

sectors.name: Le Corbier
sectors.notes: 1550 m resort elevation; 2265 m is Pointe du Corbier, not yet confirmed as the highest lift-served point.

sectors.name: La Toussuire
sectors.notes: 1800 m resort elevation; 2431 m is the Ouillon landmark. Do not label as lift-top without map verification.

sectors.name: Saint-Jean-d’Arves
sectors.notes: Officially listed as part of the five-resort core; sector lift range not yet established.

sectors.name: Saint-Sorlin-d’Arves
sectors.notes: Official sector page reports 1500–2620 m, 41 marked pistes and 18 lifts.

sectors.name: Les Bottières
sectors.notes: 1300 m resort elevation; exact lift top and lift/piste edges not yet verified.

sectors.name: Saint-Colomban-des-Villards
sectors.notes: Local area information gives 1100–2233 m; current relationship to the full Sybelles pass is unresolved.

edge_policy: Populate edges only from a dated lift/piste graph and cross-check each against the official map. Each edge must carry from_node, to_node, type, name, direction, easiest_piste_grade, lift_dependency, source, confidence and verification_status.
